title: Moon in your birth chart: the mind, the mother, the rashi | Ask Tota
description: Chandra is the graha Indian astrology weights hardest. It changes sign every 2.25 days, sets your dasha, and is the rashi your family has always used.
og_title: The moon in ur chart is the one ur family meant
og_description: Chandra carries the mind, sets your dasha, and is the sign Indian families call your rashi. It is also the only graha whose benefic status changes with the calendar.
h1: the moon is the sign ur family always meant
dek: when someone asks ur rashi, they mean this one. chandra carries the mind, changes sign every two and a bit days, starts ur entire dasha sequence, and is the only graha whose benefic status changes depending on the day of the month.

faq.q: what does the moon represent in vedic astrology?
faq.a: manas, the mind. mood, memory, emotional habit, comfort, and what makes u feel safe. it also carries the mother, water, and the general public.

faq.q: why is the moon so important in indian astrology?
faq.a: three reasons stacked. it is the rashi indian families actually use, it starts the vimshottari dasha from its nakshatra, and the whole chart gets read a second time from it as chandra lagna.

faq.q: which sign does the moon rule?
faq.a: karka, and only karka. it is exalted in vrishabha, deepest at 3 degrees, and debilitated in vrishchika, deepest at 3 degrees. its mooltrikona is vrishabha from 4 to 30 degrees.

faq.q: how fast does the moon move?
faq.a: about 13 degrees a day, so it crosses a sign in roughly two and a quarter days and a nakshatra in about a day and a quarter. it is by far the fastest graha.

faq.q: is the moon a benefic or a malefic?
faq.a: it depends on the day. a waxing moon near full is a benefic, a waning moon near new is treated as a malefic. this is called paksha bala and the moon is the only graha whose classification moves like this.
reading the whole chart again with the moon's sign as the first house. vedic astrology does this routinely as a second opinion, and it is the fallback when a birth time is unknown.

no graha in the 2nd or 12th house from the moon, and none with it. the classical reading is isolation and a lack of support. it is also cancelled easily and very often, so it should never be delivered as a verdict.

faq.q: what are sunapha, anapha and durudhara yogas?
faq.a: grahas in the 2nd from the moon is sunapha, in the 12th is anapha, and in both is durudhara. they are the opposite of kemadruma and are read as support around the mind.
10 years in vimshottari. it is usually described as a period concerned with home, mother, emotional life and the public.

faq.q: which nakshatras does the moon rule?
faq.a: rohini, hasta and shravana. if ur moon sat in one of those at birth, ur dasha sequence began with the moon.

faq.q: do i need my birth time to know my moon sign?
faq.a: roughly, yes. the moon crosses a sign in about 2.25 days, so a date alone usually settles it, but if u were born near a boundary the hour decides it. the nakshatra needs more precision than the sign does.

faq.q: which house is the moon strongest in?
faq.a: the 4th, by directional strength. digbala puts the moon at full force in the house of home, mother and the emotional base, which lines up neatly with what it signifies.
